purpose: Replay every profile-diffusion setting with eight lens-geometry starts so curvature, carrier, scale, and strength effects are compared on equally robust roots.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the profile-diffusion bridge fits.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing; only lens geometry, shear, centers, and source positions are reoptimized.
This is a numerical robustness replay on already inspected development clusters, not an external holdout.
All 38 settings are replayed because derivative redistribution can cross shallow image-root boundaries.
The radial diffusion is a common profile proxy, not a complete map-based tensor theory.
